title: Object name with leading or trailing whitespace
description:
Code-style rule — an object name starts or ends with a space or tab. The whitespace is invisible in every list FileMaker shows, but it is part of the name: name-based access has to reproduce it exactly, and two names that look identical sort apart. Covers the user-named schema objects; layout objects and variables have their own rules, relationship names are derived by FileMaker.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Script Name ends in white space" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Nothing in the interface shows the space. It surfaces when a script calls the object by name, when a query filters on the name, or when someone types the name again and gets a second object that looks the same.
rule.remediation: Trim the name. Where scripts or calculations refer to it by name, update them in the same pass.
